audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3 and 4 read 'Skill' while the captions sitting on them said the opposite — whys[0] 'Riven wins level 1', whys[3] 'Levels 4-5 flip to you', whys[4] 'Level 6 stays yours'. The packet chart agrees with the captions. Row 6 read Riven; the applied mirror sets two items to Volibear.
audit.why: Three rows rendered a side that its own caption contradicted, and the last row disagreed with the already-applied mirror.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side/win[0] to Riven, phases[3].side/win[3] and phases[4].side/win[4] to Volibear, phases[6].side/win[6] to Volibear; ratings 3, 6, 6, 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2], spikes[3], late and whys[6] all treated Blade of the Exile as an execute that 'threatens you the moment you drop below half' and made Riven the stronger late duelist.
audit.why: Riot's text: she gains Attack Damage and Range and may use Wind Slash, one ranged attack, during the ult. There is no health-threshold execute anywhere in the kit, and the mirror corrected the same claim from its side. With row 6 now Volibear, the late-game captions had to move with it.
audit.corrected: Blade of the Exile: 120/90/60s, bonus AD and range, one Wind Slash ranged attack. At two items Volibear's bulk and the Frenzied Maul re-bite outlast it.

audit.why: The kit facts that matter are on the page and correct: Ki Burst is the stun (260 range, 11/10/9/8/7s), Broken Wings is the three-cast dash chain with the knockback on the third (13s), Valor is the step plus damage block (10/9/8/7/6s). Thundering Smash's 12s and Frenzied Maul's 5s re-bite were already put right by the mirror on the other side.
audit.corrected: Valor's 6s rank-5 timer added to the first-item caption as the concrete reason her cooldowns beat yours there.

edits.before: At 2+ items Riven's mobility and R execute keep her the stronger duelist without your R up.
edits.after: At 2+ items your bulk takes over — Wind Slash is one ranged hit, not an execute.

edits.before: Riven's first-item spike is brutal — with cooldowns low she chains Broken Wings and E shield faster than your W stacks come up, and her R execute threatens you the moment you drop below half.
edits.after: Riven's first-item spike is brutal — with cooldowns low she chains Broken Wings and a Valor shield that is back every 6s at rank 5, and Blade of the Exile adds AD, range and one Wind Slash.

edits.before: Riven stays the stronger duelist with mobility and burst; you need R up and a landed Q stun to win, otherwise she Q-E-cancels out of your Frenzied Maul and resets the trade.
edits.after: By two items you are the stronger duelist: Wind Slash is a single ranged hit, and Stormbringer's bonus Health plus the Frenzied Maul re-bite outlast her 13s Broken Wings chain.

edits.before: Level 6 and first item swing back to Riven: her low-cooldown combo and R execute out-burst you, so you only win the all-in with R Stormbringer online and a clean Q stun to lock her mid-animation.
edits.after: First item swings back to Riven: low cooldowns and Blade of the Exile's bonus AD and range out-burst you there, so you win the all-in only with Stormbringer up and a clean stun mid-animation.

edits.before: Levels 3 she keeps the lead with her full combo and Valor shield, but at 4-5 your Q-W weight and Relentless Storm stacks pull two even windows where a landed stun turns the trade your way.
edits.after: Level 3 she keeps the lead with her full combo and the Valor shield, but at 4-5 your Q-W weight and passive stacks take over: a landed stun into both Frenzied Maul bites wins the trade outright.

notes: The mirror reported that the FULL-layer prose on this matchup carries mojibake em dashes on disk, which is why it restricted itself to clean-ASCII enum fields there. I have done the same: every full-layer edit here is an enum (side or rating), and all prose corrections are made in the content layer, where the strings are clean. If a later pass repairs the encoding, phases[0].why and phases[5].why on this page still need rewriting — [0] currently says 'even exchanges favour you' under a Riven row, and [5] never mentions that Valor blocks the damage you open with. packet suspectName 'Relentless Storm' is a FALSE POSITIVE (real Volibear passive).
